c74object.name: el.channel~
c74object.digest: Extracts a specific sample channel/index from an incoming audio vector
c74object.description:
el.channel~ is a utility to probe a specific position within a vector. It samples the incoming signal vector at the target index once per vector block and outputs that constant value as a continuous signal across the full vector size. This is particularly useful for examining specific bins within FFT data.
Inlets
Left Inlet (signal/int/float): Incoming audio signal vector to sample, or an integer/float value to update the target index.
Right Inlet (int): Target sample channel/index position within the incoming vector.
Outlets
Left Outlet (signal): Extracted channel value distributed across the output signal vector. Outputs 0.0 if the index is out of bounds.

objarg.name: channel
objarg.description: The location index inside the incoming vector to peek. This value should be between 0 to (N-1) inclusive where N is the current Signal Vector Size. Defaults to 0 if not specified.

method.name: int
method.digest: Set the target sample index via integer
method.description: Changes the sample index location to extract from the vector. Sent to the left inlet or the right inlet (`in1`), it updates the active index directly.

method.name: channel
method.digest: Set the target sample index via float
method.description: Set the location inside the buffer to peek. The float value is truncated to a long index integer internally. This value should be between 0 to (N-1) inclusive where N is the Signal Vector Size.
